subject: Propulsion: Annual Planning Kickoff & Scenario Playbook
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Propulsion: Annual Planning Kickoff & Scenario Playbook

Team —

Kicking off annual planning. I want this thread to be the canonical place for leadership-level OSS (objectives, signal, scenarios) for FY27 planning. High level asks in this first note:

1) Review attached master workbook (2027_planning_propulsion_master.xlsx) — tabs: targets, scenario assumptions, resource levers, timeline.
2) Pick owners for: revenue targets, cost scenarios, hiring envelope, and contingency triggers.
3) Confirm calendar for QBR prep: propose week of Nov 29 for the leadership dry-run; draft QBR to execs Dec 14.

Why "Propulsion"? We need a small set of clear target bands + trigger-based playbooks rather than a single point estimate. The attached scenario-definitions-v2.pdf shows three scenarios (Base, Upside, Conserved Flow) and a triage ladder for hard decisions.

Immediate asks (please reply within 48 hours):
- Jonas: lead revenue targets + top 3 GTM moves to hit Upside.
- Lauren: validate OKR slates and org-level dependencies.
- Marissa: resource and hiring envelope — where can we compress headcount without degrading key path?
- Vanessa: ops/infra cost sanity check and critical capacity gating.
- Kim/David: finance inputs — I need committed run-rate numbers for Nov 12.

Links: Google sheet (master) and a working folder in Drive are in related_links. I've also penciled a 60-min kickoff on the calendar for tomorrow to align on owners if this thread doesn't surface concerns.

This is intentionally compact; we'll expand with owner-level action items after your replies. If you see conflicts with other deadlines, flag here and I'll reprioritize.

Thanks —
Vivek

Vivek Kulkarni
CEO (interim) — Redwood Inference
(Attachment: 2027_planning_propulsion_master.xlsx [spreadsheet], scenario-definitions-v2.pdf [pdf], qbr-prep-checklist.docx [docx])

Subject: Re: Propulsion: Annual Planning Kickoff & Scenario Playbook

Vivek — thanks for the clear framing. I will take revenue targets and draft three GTM levers mapped to each scenario by Nov 8. Quick note on timeline: finance needs a confirmed demand and pricing assumption set one week before Nov 12 to model. Can we lock in a brief pricing/packaging session on Nov 4 (30m)?

Also — for Upside, I'd like to test a mixed GTM approach (enterprise push + product-led expansion credits) rather than purely enterprise-led. Will outline in my deliverable.

- Jonas

I will take hiring envelope and resource levers. High-level input: we can compress up to 12% of planned hires in the short timeline by delaying non-critical IC roles and shifting contractors to SOWs — that yields ~3.2M in savings in H1. I'll lay out which teams to pause and the customer impact matrix by Nov 10.

Also, I recommend a hard freeze date for new reqs during the Nov 15–Dec 15 window unless approved by me+Lauren.

Marissa

- Revenue recognition changes tied to usage credits should be reconciled with legal (I'll loop in Legal separately).

Great progress — thanks for the quick turns. Two operational notes before we close the first week:

1) I've scheduled a 60-min alignment tomorrow (Nov 5, 10:00–11:00 PT) — calendar link in related_links. Please come with owner-level commitments for your deliverables.
2) Emma (external) will run a short QBR facilitation session with us on Nov 29 — I've looped her in to keep the runbook crisp.

Action items recap (owners & due dates):
- Jonas: revenue levers + pricing assumptions (Nov 8)
- Lauren: OKR one-pager & story arc (Nov 9)
- Marissa: hiring compression plan + freeze recommendation (Nov 10)
- Vanessa: infra risk register & cost owner one-pager (Nov 5)
- Kimberly/David: draft finance model (Nov 11)

If anything slips outside the dates above tag here and propose new dates — we need these artifacts for the leadership dry-run week of Nov 29.

Thanks —
Vivek
